meta.parties: Juanis Et Al. v. Dissanaike Et Al

rules.statement: An incoming tenant has no general right of action against the outgoing tenant for damages for waste committed by the latter on the land leased, but facts admitted or proved may disclose liability in the outgoing tenant to the incoming tenant.
rules.supporting_quote: "As a general rule an. incoming tenant has no right of action against the outgoing tenant for damages for waste committed by the latter on the land leased. He must look to his landlord to put him in possession of the land leased in such order as ho and the landlord agreed on. If, however, the outgoing tenant has acted contrary to local custom, facts admitted or proved in a case may disclose liability in him to the incoming tenant."
